verdict.rationale: Clerk is an authentication and user-management platform, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The evidence shows Clerk serving its own MCP server, acting as an OAuth authorization server for MCP clients, and gating tool calls for developers' agents. None of that shows Clerk itself plugging in external MCP servers to use their tools, so the axis does not apply.
